RUS.hook: Spans eleven time zones — when Monday morning starts in Kaliningrad it is already Monday evening in Kamchatka.
RUS.place: From the Baltic to the Pacific across the whole top of Asia. Kaliningrad is a detached piece between Poland and Lithuania.

UKR.hook: The largest country lying entirely within Europe, sitting on roughly a third of the world's black-earth chernozem soil.
UKR.place: North of the Black Sea, filling the space between Poland and Russia.

BLR.hook: About 40% forest, and it shares the Białowieża primeval woodland — and its bison — with Poland.
BLR.place: Landlocked between Poland and Russia, directly above Ukraine.

MDA.hook: One of the most wine-dependent economies anywhere — the Cricova cellars alone run for over 120km underground, with streets and traffic signs.
MDA.place: The small landlocked country wedged between Romania and Ukraine.
